plain_text:
PRESENT: 
Jo-Ann Keegan, Chairperson 
Kathleen Cullen-Lutter, Member 
William Galvin Member 
Erin Gendron, Member 
Alison Keegan, Member 
Lisa Golden, Director of Health & Human Services 
 
Chairperson Jo-Ann Keegan called the September 2, 2026 meeting of the Board of Health to order at 6:00PM. 
 
 
9/2/2026 – Minutes 
 
1. NEW BUSINESS 
1.I. For Approval: Minutes of the August 5, 2026 meeting of the Board of Health 
Board Member William Galvin asked for a correction of the date in agenda item 3.1 to September 2, 2026 
Motion: To accept the minutes of August 5, 2026 with the correction made by made by William Galvin, seconded by 
Kathleen Cullen-Lutter. 
 
1.II. For Review: Tobacco Control Monthly Report Submitted by Cesar Pungirum, Program Director 
Tobacco Control Director Cesar Pungirum reviewed the monthly report with the Board. The Board accepted and 
placed on file. 
 
1.III. Request to Attend: Abena Alwedyan Lowell Quick Stop Corp 189 East Merrimack St 
Tobacco Control Director Cesar Pungirum reviewed the circumstances regarding Lowell Quick Mart Inc.,189 E. 
Merrimack St violation for sale of tobacco products to a minor and ongoing issue with the Tobacco Sales permit.  Sr. 
Sanitary Code Inspector Matthew Sheehan spoke regarding the issuance of a Food Permit. As of September 2, 2026, 
the establishment still does not hold a Tobacco Sales permit or a Food permit.   
Lowell Quick Mart owner Ms. Abena Alwedyan, 189 E. Merrimack St Lowell, was present to address the Board. The 
Board discussed the expectations with Ms. Alwedyan who will bring the required documentation to Development 
Services so the food permit can be issued. Afterwards the Tobacco Sales permit can be issued if the meeting 
regarding the Tobacco Regulations has been held and the documentation for that permit has been received.   
  
1.IV. For Review: Development Services Monthly Reports 
Sr. Sanitary Code Inspector Matthew Sheehan reviewed the reports with the Board. The Board accepted and placed 
on file. 
 
1.V. For Review: PrideStar EMS, Inc. Reports and Notifications submitted by Jon Kelley 
The Board accepted and placed on file. Director Golden informed the Board that PrideStar was approved to receive 
some Opioid Settlement funds to start the Buprenorphine Administration program. 
 
1.VI. Informational: Withdrawal from Microblading Apprenticeship 
The Board accepted the communication and placed on file. 
 
Approved as amended 
10.7.26 BOH Meeting
BOHM09022026 
Page 2 
 
1.VII. Informational: CMMCP September Mosquito Spray Schedule 
The Board accepted the communication and placed on file.  Director Golden updated the Board regarding the recent 
notification of a trapped mosquito that tested positive for West Nile Virus and noted that the CMMCP was going to 
the neighborhood to spray. CMMCP will continue to spray in instances of positive mosquitoes although resident 
requested services have stopped for the season. 
 
1.VIII. Informational: August 13, 2026 Press Release regarding Kratom 
The Board accepted and placed on file. 
 
1.IX. Informational: September 19, 2026 Unwanted Medication Takeback Day 
The Board noted the date and encouraged people to bring in their unwanted medication for disposal. 
 
2. OLD BUSINESS 
 
3. DEPARTMENTAL/DIVISIONAL REPORTS AND UPDATES 
 
3.I. Department and Divisional Reports 
Health & Human Services Director Golden reviewed the reports with the Board and noted that the flu clinics will 
most likely occur in October.  The Board accepted the reports and placed on file.  Chairwoman Keegan noted that 
she would be sending the Law Department a request for information regarding records about the previously 
proposed trash transfer station at 10-12 Tanner St so the Board can be prepared for any upcoming proposals for the 
site. 
 
4. MOTION TO ADJOURN 
 
4.I. Motion to Adjourn 
Motion: To adjourn the September 2, 2026 meeting of the Board of Health at 6:50PM made by William Galvin, 
seconded by Kathleen Cullen-Lutter.  All in favor. 
 
 
 
 
THE NEXT MEETING OF THE LOWELL BOARD OF HEALTH WILL BE HELD ON 
OCTOBER 7, 2026 AT 6:00PM 
IN THE MAYOR'S RECEPTION ROOM, CITY HALL, 375 MERRIMACK ST 2ND FLOOR
